text:
natalie (partnerships): FYI OpenFlux pinged about collecting lightweight telemetry from marketplace bundles to demonstrate perf and help routing. Can we agree boundaries? cc @sarah @aj @marco

sarah (legal): High level: must be opt-in per vendor/customer, no raw prompts, no PII, retention caps, and a simple deletion/ERASURE workflow. Also want a manifest signature requirement so we can verify bundle provenance.

aj (eng): Technically we can accept aggregated metrics only (latency, error_rate, tokens). Example event: `model_id=openflux-13B latency_ms=120 tokens=256 errors=0.01`. We should ban any free-text fields.

emily (partnerships): Marketplace teams want a clear checkbox in onboarding that the vendor agrees telemetry contains no prompts or user ids, and a link to the telemetry addendum.

marco (privacy): Strong +1. Recommend pseudonymous client_id only, retention default 90 days, optional 180 for enterprise with contract. Offer DP toggle for privacy-sensitive customers.

vendor-openflux: We only need anonymous perf signals to tune quantization and routing. We will provide `manifest_hash` and `signature` and avoid any prompt content. Can accept DP.
notes: sarah will draft addendum; aj to post sample manifest + telemetry schema; schedule 30m sync with OpenFlux tomorrow 10am PT
